name: Daynori Ask Nori text-assistant release-gate verification and reviewed organizer creation audit

provider.gateStatus: blocked (fail-closed pending commercial terms, enterprise DPA, and owner spending authorization)

privacyAndSecurityGuarantees.zeroModelTraining: Mandatory DPA addendum prohibiting training of base or fine-tuned models on user data.
privacyAndSecurityGuarantees.vaultExclusion: Unconditional exclusion via isVaultAiTarget. Vault notes, encrypted files, and keys fail closed with HTTP 403 vault_excluded.
privacyAndSecurityGuarantees.journalOptIn: Default-off (contentScope.journal = false). Refuses to index or draft journal entries without explicit user opt-in in Settings.
privacyAndSecurityGuarantees.workspaceIsolation: Strict multi-tenant boundary. Zero cross-workspace retrieval, citation, or proposal modification.
privacyAndSecurityGuarantees.retentionPolicy: Zero server disk logging of prompt text or completions. 30-day transient provider abuse monitoring cap.

reviewedCreationLifecycle.dateAmbiguityDetection: Mandatory clarification question when relative dates ('yesterday', 'tomorrow') lack ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
reviewedCreationLifecycle.editablePreview: PATCH /v1/ai/proposals/:proposalId allows modifying title, content, date, amount before saving.
reviewedCreationLifecycle.explicitConfirmation: POST /v1/ai/proposals/:proposalId/confirm requires opaque single-use server confirmation token.
reviewedCreationLifecycle.canonicalDeepLinks: Verified navigation via getOrganizerDeepLink for notes, tasks, and journals.
reviewedCreationLifecycle.idempotentRetry: Re-confirming returns existing entity without duplication.
reviewedCreationLifecycle.cancelledProposalZeroWrite: Cancelling writes zero rows to domain tables.

killSwitchTiers.serverEnvironment: DAYNORI_ASSISTANT_KILL_SWITCH=true halts all endpoints with HTTP 503 AI_KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE.
killSwitchTiers.workspaceAdmin: ai_enabled = false in workspace settings revokes consent and purges index chunks.
killSwitchTiers.clientUiBanner: assistant-gated-banner renders on Web and Mobile informing users of DEF-V2-008 gating.
